name: fused_moe
description: Unquantized mixture of experts. For each token, take the expert ids and routing weights from topk_output=(topk_weights,topk_ids,router_aux); router_aux is unused. Each expert projects hidden_states with w1=[E,2*I,H], splits the gate and up halves, and feeds activation(gate) * up through w2=[E,H,I]. Sum the routed expert outputs with their weights and multiply by routed_scaling_factor. The supported activations are SiLU and GELU. Return a new [T,H] tensor with the dtype and device of hidden_states.
